sections.Profile:
The "Trio" pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in November 1965, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a musical theme. Designed by Ted Zale, it features two flippers, four pop bumpers, four mushroom bumpers, two slingshots, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Good Times, Singing, Dancing, Music
